notes: Ruling needed (rule 11, two sayings with their own isnads): the second isnad «وعن ابن شهاب عن سعيد بن المسيب قال كان عمر وعثمان يفعلان ذلك» reports a different saying (the practice of Umar and Uthman), so it is not written as a route of this one
